sahil (sdk): repro for Next/Edge sample app — hitting a token refresh + auth retry loop in production only.

emma (devex): ugh, can you paste the package.json exports and the sample app's import?

sahil (sdk): sure. app imports: `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` in edge function. package.json has conditional exports and a types entry that points to dist/index.d.ts. snippet below:

sahil (sdk): ```json
{
  "name": "redwood-sdk",
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "dist/esm/index.js",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
    },
    "./package.json": { "default": "./package.json" }
  }
}
```

lucas (platform): do we ship an edge-friendly build? ESM-only bundles tend to work better on Vercel Edge. This dual-package setup can cause Node resolve differences at runtime.

tanya (onboarding): the sample app we shipped in docs uses the CJS entry in dev which might hide the issue. Does the prod bundle end up resolving the CJS path?

sahil (sdk): repro steps: on edge runtime the import gets transpiled to dynamic import of the CJS file by Next, then our auth layer (client) tries to use global fetch+Headers and a token refresh path that assumes setImmediate/nextTick for retry backoff. On edge those are missing and our fallback polyfilled code calls fetch repeatedly because the retry timer doesn't clear.

emma (devex): that explains the loop. So two problems: conditional exports resolution mismatch + runtime assumptions (timers/polyfills).

lucas (platform): quick fix options:
- provide an explicit `exports."./edge"` or an `exports.import` pointing to an ESM edge-optimized build with a small runtime shim
- make the auth/retry layer edge-safe by using await sleep with Promise-based timers and not rely on node timers or globals

sahil (sdk): i tried a minimal patch: add `exports: { "./edge": { "import": "./dist/esm/edge.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/edge.cjs" }, ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" } }` and produce dist/esm/edge.js that uses fetch-only and a tiny retry util. locally works on vercel dev but still seeing weirdness in a customer's Cloudflare Workers environment.

tanya (onboarding): can we change the sample app to import from 'redwood-sdk/edge' explicitly? That would be straightforward for docs and avoid resolve ambiguity for newcomers.

emma (devex): yes please — update the sample and note in the quickstart: "For edge runtimes, import 'redwood-sdk/edge' or set conditional export with ./edge." Keep a short note about types path too.

sahil (sdk): types gotcha: TS picks up the root `types` field, but when consumers import subpath `redwood-sdk/edge` the d.ts must be reachable. need to add `typesVersions` or `exports."./edge"` with `types` mapping. Example fix in package.json:

sahil (sdk): ```json
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" },
  "./edge": { "import": "./dist/esm/edge.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/edge.cjs", "types": "./dist/edge.d.ts" }
}
```

lucas (platform): good. Also add a small smoke test in the sample-app CI that deploys to an edge preview or runs a worker-like environment to catch this early.

tanya (onboarding): i'll update the sample app PR to import `/edge`, add a README blurb, and include a minimal reproducible test. tagging @emma for docs copy.

emma (devex): thanks. can someone open a meta-issue for dual-publish policy with a checklist: edge build, exports./edge, types for subpath, runtime-safe retry util, sample-app CI? i can convert to a playbook afterwards.

sahil (sdk): opened issue #3892 (internal) with repro and attached logs, steps, and proposed package.json diff. assigning to lucas for platform changes and tanya for sample updates.

ci-bot: deployment preview created: https://preview.app/vercel/redwood-sample/edge-auth-fix (reaction :white_check_mark:)

lucas (platform): next steps: 1) land edge-optimized build 2) harden retry util 3) docs/sample update 4) CI smoke. i'll draft a small RFC for any breaking public API changes.

tanya (onboarding): PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/72 (imports edge, adds test)

emma (devex): awesome. note for docs: "If you see constant token refresh loops in an edge runtime, check your package exports and prefer the edge entrypoint or ensure your SDK uses Promise-based timers and fetch-only APIs."

sahil (sdk): thanks team. posting a short internal KB after we merge.

lucas (platform): :thumbsup:
